questions.prompt: Which statement correctly describes Pull Request Events?
options: Print all environment variables and event payloads to make the run easier to debug.
Run untrusted pull-request code in the same job that holds production credentials.
Pull-request workflows validate proposed changes before merge and must treat forked or contributor-controlled source content as untrusted.
Give every job write permission to avoid troubleshooting authorization errors.
questions.answer_key: Pull-request workflows validate proposed changes before merge and must treat forked or contributor-controlled source content as untrusted.
questions.explanation: This is the central behavior of pull request events: Pull-request workflows validate proposed changes before merge and must treat forked or contributor-controlled source content as untrusted. Validate configuration and behavior against the current official reference before production use.

Assume the workflow is correct as soon as the YAML file is committed.

questions.explanation: Reliable verification uses observable evidence.
